The contract is its own HyperCore actor: it bridges USDC to Core, class-transfers to perp, places the short hedge, and reads its Core equity back through the read precompiles. Execution lives ONCE in DNCoreBase; this contract adds the honest-accounting + vault wiring. HONEST ACCOUNTING (repo discipline \u2014 see SkyStrategy/MorphoStrategy audits): - `corePrincipal6`  = net USDC we sent to Core (never counted as yield). - `coreEquity6`     = Core account value, refreshed by syncCore() reads. - profit on Core    = equity - principal; only the EXCESS is realizable. - `profitRealized`  = profit actually bridged back to EVM (underlying units). - harvest() by the VAULT sweeps realized profit above the liquidity buffer   to the vault; by the keeper it only syncs (settle, no movement). owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setPerpAsset(uint32).details: Only while the position is flat — avoids reinterpreting an open hedge.

setSpotConfig(uint64).details: Only while flat — avoids reinterpreting an open hedge.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

bridgeBackToEvm(uint64).notice: Return USDC Core->EVM (sendAsset to the USDC system address). Requires HYPE on Core for transfer gas. Splits the amount at the FRESHLY-SYNCED equity: while equity > principal, an outflow draws from the PROFIT portion FIRST (principal stays invested, keeping the hedge margin sized), so a profit-sized skim realizes profit instead of silently consuming principal basis (round-2 HIGH-1).   profitAvail = max(0, equity - principal)   profitRed   = min(amount, profitAvail);  principalRed = amount - profitRed Full-amount drains are unchanged (profitAvail is realized, the rest is principal); in a loss (equity < principal) every unit is principal.

bridgeUsdcToCore(uint256).notice: Bridge USDC EVM->Core (lands in the contract's SPOT balance). Initializes the Core account; actions must be sent in a LATER block.

coreScale().notice: Scale from Core 6dp USDC to underlying token units (1 for real USDC; 1e12 for an 18-decimals test token).

delegateHype(address,uint64,bool).notice: Delegate / undelegate staked HYPE to a validator (action 3).

harvestableProfit().notice: Realized profit still waiting to be swept (underlying units).

hedgeTransferOut(address,uint64).notice: Spot-send the hedge straight from the contract's Core spot balance (action 6) — the unwind path for hedge sizes below HL's $10 order minimum (orders can't express them; a send can).

marginSummary().notice: NOTE: takes (perpDexIndex, user) — verified against mainnet.

moveUsdcToPerp(uint64).notice: Move USDC spot→perp (or back) on Core. `ntl` is USDC perp units (6 decimals; 1 USDC = 1e6).

openShort(uint32,uint64,uint64,uint8).notice: Open the short hedge (sell perp). limitPx/sz are 10^8 × human value; sz must respect the asset's szDecimals (keeper reads 0x80a).

openSpotBuy(uint64,uint64,uint8).notice: Buy the spot hedge — the LONG leg that cancels the short's price exposure (HIGH-2 fix). `limitPx`/`sz` are 10^8 × human value; sz must respect the pair's szDecimals (keeper derives from pxScale). HL spot orders enforce a $10 minimum on the REQUESTED notional.

perpAsset().notice: HyperCore perp asset index (0 = BTC, 1 = ETH on validator perps).

recall(uint256).notice: Return funds to the vault so it can honor user withdrawals. Callable ONLY by the vault address (set via setVault). Capped at balance.

sellSpot(uint64,uint64,uint8).notice: Sell the spot hedge (unwind path). Spot orders take no reduceOnly flag. Requests under $10 are rejected by HL — use hedgeTransferOut for sub-$10 hedge sizes.

setSpotConfig(uint64).notice: Configure the spot hedge pair (HIGH-2). Derives everything from the live 0x80b/0x80c reads: base token index + szDecimals → px scale.

spotHedgeSz().notice: Spot hedge size (1e8 units — Core spot wei for HYPE). Safe: 0 when the spot leg is unconfigured or the read fails.

spotPairIndex().notice: Spot hedge config (HIGH-2 fix). `spotPairIndex` = HyperCore spot pair index (e.g. 107 = HYPE/USDC); `spotTokenIndex` = derived base-token index; `spotAsset` = spot ORDER asset (10000 + pairIndex); `spotPxScale` = 10^(10 - szDecimals) so spotValue6 = spotSz(1e8) * spotPxRaw / scale yields USDC 6dp. 0 = spot leg disabled — never claim delta-neutral then.

spotPx().notice: Live spot price for the hedge pair (raw; human px = raw / 10^(8 - szDecimals)). Safe: 0 on failure.

spotValue6().notice: Spot hedge value in USDC 6dp. Safe: 0 on any read failure — totalAssets math must never revert on a precompile hiccup.

stakeHype(uint64).notice: Stake HYPE held on the contract's Core spot balance (action 4). Owner-gated: policy op, not routine keeper work.

syncCore().notice: Refresh Core equity + position from HyperCore state. Permissionless: it only records what the precompiles report.

totalAssets().notice: Strategy assets in underlying units: synced Core equity (perp margin side) + the SPOT HEDGE at the live spot mark (HIGH-2 — the long leg is a real asset and must count) + idle EVM balance. Every spot read is failure-safe (spotValue6() → 0), so withdraw math can never revert on a precompile hiccup.

withdrawStake(uint64).notice: Withdraw HYPE from staking back to Core spot (action 5).
